DIRECT CLUTCH DISASSEMBLY

1. CHECK PACK CLEARANCE OF DIRECT CLUTCH
(a) Place the direct clutch assembly onto the O/D support assembly.

D5151    Z05206

(b) Using SST and a dial indicator, measure the direct clutch pack clearance while applying and releasing compressed air (186-206 kPa, 1.9-2.1 kgf/cm², 27-30 psi).
SST 09350-30020    (09350-06120)
Pack clearance:
0.50 - 0.80 mm (0.0197 - 0.0315 in.)
If the values are non-standard inspect the discs.
